title: The Sealed Letter
description: You are already running. The letter in your coat is hotter than the rain.

scenes.description: Rain sheets off the rooftops. You are already mid-stride through a cutthroat alley — boots hammering the cobbles behind you, a wax-sealed letter burning against your ribs. Your employer's name is on the wrong lips tonight. The river gate is two turns away. The baker's chimney is open and hungry. A scaffold leans against the roof where you could vanish… or watch who comes for you.

choices.label: Keep the letter — run for the river
choices.resultText: You clutch the seal and cut hard for the black water. The chase does not end; it only changes rivers.
choices.stakes: You keep the secret — and the target on your back.

choices.label: Burn the letter in the baker's oven
choices.resultText: You fling the packet into the oven mouth. Wax screams. Ash lifts like a black prayer. Whatever was written is gone — and so is your only proof.
choices.stakes: Irreversible. The words die. So do some futures.

choices.label: Hide and watch who comes
choices.resultText: You press into a rain barrel's shadow. Three cloaks pass, then a fourth with a silver pin you know too well — your own employer's house mark.
choices.stakes: You learn a betrayal. You risk being seen.

scenes.description: The river gate is half-open for a grain barge. Lanterns swing. A dock clerk waves you through if you pay — or you can swim the pilings and hope the current is kinder than the crossbows.

choices.label: Bribe the clerk with your last coin
choices.resultText: Coin changes hands. The clerk forgets your face with professional speed.
choices.stakes: Safer passage; emptier purse.

choices.label: Swim the pilings under the barge
choices.resultText: Cold black water. A crossbow bolt kisses the wood above your head. You haul yourself onto the far quay, letter still dry against your chest.
choices.stakes: Risk drowning and bolts; keep moving free.

scenes.description: Flour dust and smoke fill the bakery. The baker swears in three languages. Outside, the chase falters — they wanted the letter, not a wet thief with empty hands. Someone still knows your face.

choices.label: Apologize and help smother the oven
choices.resultText: You and the baker beat the flames down. She shoves a heel of bread into your hands and a look that says: leave the city.
choices.stakes: A small ally; no letter.

choices.label: Slip out the side door before questions
choices.resultText: You are gone before the night watch arrives. Ash still greys your sleeves.
choices.stakes: Clean exit; the city remembers a fire.

scenes.description: From the scaffold you see the silver pin clearly: House Veyra, the people who hired you. The cloaks below fan out, searching. One stops, looks up — almost at you — then moves on. The letter still burns in your coat.

choices.label: Drop to the alley and shadow them
choices.resultText: You learn their route ends at the counting-house, not the docks. The letter was never meant to leave the city.
choices.stakes: Intel on the betrayal; more heat.

choices.label: Take the roofs toward the safehouse
choices.resultText: Tiles slick with rain. You outrun the pin and the boots, letter unopened, trust in ashes.
choices.stakes: Escape with the secret intact.

scenes.description: A narrow room above a chandler's shop. One lamp. One chair. The city's noise is a distant sea. You can finally breathe — until you notice the second cup on the table, still warm.

choices.label: Search the room before you sit
choices.resultText: Behind a loose board: a second seal, cracked, addressed in the same hand as your letter. Someone was here first.
choices.stakes: You may find a trap — or a warning.

choices.label: Bar the door and try to sleep
choices.resultText: Exhaustion wins. You dream of wax and rain. Something knocks three times before dawn.
choices.stakes: Rest now; face the door later.

choices.label: Open the warm cup's companion letter (if any)
choices.resultText: Only dregs. No letter in the cup — but a thumbprint in the dust matches the silver-pin gloves.
choices.stakes: Confirm someone close was here.

scenes.description: Three knocks. Measured. Polite. The kind of knock that already owns a key. Dawn is a grey knife under the door.

choices.label: Open the door — letter still sealed
choices.resultText: A courier in Veyra grey. They do not ask for the letter. They say: 'The contents were never for you. Run farther.' Then they are gone — and your employer has been playing both sides.
choices.stakes: Only if you kept the letter.

choices.label: Open the door — hands empty of proof
choices.resultText: The same grey courier. They smell ash on you. 'Good,' they say. 'Some words should die.' A purse hits the table. Blood money for silence.
choices.stakes: Only if you burned the letter.

choices.label: Open the door — you saw the silver pin
choices.resultText: No courier. Your contact from House Veyra stands in the frame, pin bright, smile thin. 'You watched,' they say. 'So now you choose: partner… or problem.'
choices.stakes: Only if you hid and watched.

choices.label: Climb out the window before answering
choices.resultText: You leave the warm cup and the knock behind. The city opens like a wound. Whatever waited at the door will find another.
choices.stakes: Refuse the callback — carry the heat into day.

scenes.description: First light over the slate roofs. The letter's fate is already a scar on the city — kept, burned, or used as a mirror. This is not the end of the story. It is the first page you cannot unread.

choices.label: Swear to open the letter at noon in the square
choices.resultText: You choose spectacle. By noon the square will be a stage — and you the fool or the firebrand.
choices.stakes: Public truth. Maximum heat.

choices.label: Live as if the words never existed
choices.resultText: Ash on your sleeves. Coin in your purse. A city that will still whisper your name when the baker tells the story.
choices.stakes: Silence purchased. Ghosts unpaid.

choices.label: Take Veyra's offer — for now
choices.resultText: You shake a gloved hand. The pin flashes. Partnership is just another word for leash — but leashes cut both ways.
choices.stakes: Power with a collar.

choices.label: Leave the city before the bells
choices.resultText: Roads out. Rain still falling. You are not free — but you are moving. The sealed letter (or its absence) walks with you.
choices.stakes: Flight. The story follows.
